notes.notes: [p]Hello all,[/p][p][/p][p]We are very excited to give announcements on My Child New Beginnings. However this time, we have some bad news to make. [/p][p][/p][p]My Child New Beginnings is releasing on all mobile platforms before end of 2025 - release date announcement countdown here: [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZohWAu2WaxA"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]However, the PC release of the game is still in the makings. This is because preparing game builds for different platforms take time, and we are a small company. We have been creating our game for the mobile platform first, as the mobile version of the game is not only a good baseline but also the most accessible for our audience due to it following a free to play base game.[/p][p][/p][p]We appreciate your patience and understanding, and look forward to sharing more about the PC release in the future years.[/p][p][/p][p]Best,[/p][p]Sarepta Studio[/p]
